# Invite a teammate

Bringing someone new onto your team — a new hire, a contractor, a co-founder — takes two clicks from your side and a click from theirs.

## 1. Open Team members

Every teammate with access to your TrustedLogin team shows up here — name, email, role, and when they last signed in. Owners and admins can invite new teammates; regular members can't.

![Open Team members](/img/guides/invite-teammate/01-open-team-members.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-members -->

## 2. Review pending invitations

The **Invitations** page shows everyone who has been invited but hasn't accepted yet. If a teammate says they never got the invite email, check here first — you can resend the same invite or revoke it and start over.

Click **New invitation** to invite someone new.

![Review pending invitations](/img/guides/invite-teammate/02-review-pending-invitations.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/invitations -->

## 3. Fill in the invitation

Enter the email address you want to invite. Pick a role:

- **Member** — can log into customer sites and see activity. Typical for support staff.
- **Admin** — everything a member can do, plus invite additional teammates and change team settings. Typical for a support lead.
- **Owner** — full control, including billing and team deletion. You can have more than one owner.

Click **Send invitation** when you're ready. TrustedLogin emails the address with a secure link to accept.

![Fill in the invitation](/img/guides/invite-teammate/03-fill-in-the-invitation.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/invitations/create -->

## 4. Your teammate accepts the invitation

Your teammate gets an email with a **Join team** button. Clicking it takes them to TrustedLogin — if they don't have an account yet, they can create one on the spot; if they do, they just sign in and the team appears in their account.

Invitations expire after 7 days. If your teammate doesn't get to it in time, you can resend from the Invitations page without having to re-enter their details.

![Your teammate accepts the invitation](/img/guides/invite-teammate/04-your-teammate-accepts-the-invitation.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/invitations/create -->

## 5. Change a teammate's role or remove them

Back on **Team members**, clicking a teammate's row opens their details. Change their role with the **Role** dropdown and save. If someone's leaving the team, scroll to the Danger zone and click **Remove from team** — their access is revoked immediately and they can't log into any customer sites through your team.

Removing a teammate does **not** delete their TrustedLogin account — they can still use TrustedLogin on any other team they're on.

![Change a teammate's role or remove them](/img/guides/invite-teammate/05-change-a-teammate-s-role-or-remove-them.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-members -->

## Who can invite new teammates

Team **owners** and **admins** can invite. Regular members can't — the Invite option won't show up in their sidebar.

## If the invite email doesn't arrive

Email deliverability is the single most common issue here. Check:

1. **Spam / promotions folders.** TrustedLogin invites come from a `trustedlogin.com` address but spam filters can still flag them.
2. **The Invitations page.** Is the invite still listed as **Pending**? If yes, TrustedLogin sent it — the issue is on the receiving mailbox. Resend from there.
3. **Typos in the email address.** Revoke the bad invite and start over with the correct address.
